summary: Iteration 47 - Core Committee feature + print polish + rename. Backend pytest 6/7 pass. UI: SuperAdmin /site core tabs, Core Project create (AE/CPRJ/T0001/2627, member auto 'Member Civil'), Core Working Form (unit Cum, cum 30, 30%), Core Escalation (daysOpen 4, suggested L2, ESCALATE badge), /core-dashboard 4 tabs + 30% progress + open escalation + Procurement extra KPIs, Users create form with Core Member roles, Member OHE login -> /core-dashboard with ONLY Member OHE tab, API filtered to OHE, POST CIVIL -> 403, CORE: OWN/ALL toggle -> 4 tabs + all disciplines, plain User sees core-not-permitted, Reports Hub '6. Project Management' has 3 core reports, Reports print + Work Order print have ae-lh-img letterhead and #000 table borders, /letterhead-header.jpg 200, title 'arunerpportal', home core button. FAILURES: (1) plain 'User' role (and any non-member role e.g. Admin/HR/Accounts/Viewer) can read+create all core data via API and /site tabs; (2) OpsModule Print has no letterhead image.

critical.issue: _core_disc() returns None (=ALL) for every role that is not a 'Member *' role, so a normal 'User' (also HR/Accounts/Viewer/Purchase/Admin) gets ALL core projects/working/escalations and can create/edit them. Spec says core data visible only to GM + assigned member + SuperAdmin. Verified: plain User GET /api/ops/core_project returned both CIVIL and OHE TEST projects. Fix: in _core_disc return [] (deny) for roles not in {SuperAdmin, GM} and not Member (or core_all), and enforce same in ops_upsert/ops_delete.

minor.issue: No discipline check on delete (only ACL 'd'). If a Member is granted delete via ACL they could delete other-discipline records.
Login response 'user' object does not include core_all (frontend relies on /auth/me, works, but inconsistent).

ui_bugs.issue:
OpsModule Print window HTML has plain

M/S ARUN ENTERPRISES

with no
/'hdr', so polishPrintHtml never injects the scanned letterhead image (ae-lh-img missing). Dark border CSS IS injected. Fix: use letterheadImg() from lib/printKit in OpsModule print (as ReportsHub buildLetterhead does).
Core Projects / Working Form / Escalation tabs are shown to every role (plain User sees all disciplines' data & can Save). Should be hidden/blocked for non GM/SuperAdmin/Member roles.

issues: Discipline select (ops-f-discipline) shows all 5 disciplines to a Member OHE; choosing CIVIL only fails on save with 403 toast. Restrict options to MEMBER_DISC[role] unless core_all.

action_items: Backend: restrict core_* kinds to SuperAdmin, GM, Member roles (own disciplines or core_all). Non-member roles (User/Admin/HR/Accounts/Viewer/Purchase) must get 403 or empty list on GET and 403 on POST/DELETE.
Frontend: hide core_project/core_progress/core_escalation tabs in DEPTS.site (OpsDepartment) for non-permitted roles; filter Reports Hub core reports similarly.
OpsModule print: prepend letterheadImg() (lib/printKit) to the print HTML so the scanned letterhead appears.
Member forms: limit discipline select options to the member's disciplines.
critical_code_review_comments: _core_disc default-allow design is the root cause of data exposure; flip to default-deny for non-core roles.

core_escalation daysOpen/suggested are computed client-side and stored at save time; dashboard shows the stale stored daysOpen (won't grow day by day unless re-saved). Compute daysOpen at render time in CoreDashboard/table.
CoreDashboard tab logic uses currentRole() (localStorage) for SuperAdmin/GM but me.role for members - mixed sources; prefer me.role from /auth/me.
Core Members inherit default ACL view=True for all other departments (HR, Finance, Procurement etc.) - confirm with user if members should see entire ERP.
polishPrintHtml regex only matches exact '<div class="lh">' / '<div class=hdr>' - any header with extra classes/attributes will not get the letterhead.
server.py is 2390 lines and UsersAdmin.jsx 1077, ReportsHub.jsx 1346 - should be split.
